Perhaps he wants to LARP as you. It's being show-cased in White Wolf's
newest product, LSJ: The Ruling.

Each player takes on the role of a Designer, a supernatural being
dedicated to sifting order from chaos. Each character is driven by
powerful instincts, known as Intents. Some theorize these are a gift
from the gods, some say they come from devils, some say they are an
expression of the powerful charisma or intellect of crazed individuals.

Each Designer gets to advance different skills, known as Authorities.
At launch, these will include Correct, Card Text, Obviously True, Moot,
Dictionary Usage, Grammar, and Precedent.
